title: PartyGuard
description: Protects your party members by preventing friendly fire and other accidental damage.
body:
# PartyGuard

**PartyGuard** is an **Odin module** that enhances the built-in autokick system 
with more advanced and customizable features.

## Features
- ⚔️ Advanced autokick detection
- 🎯 More precise kick conditions than Odin's default autokick
- ⚙️ Fully configurable settings
- 🔧 Lightweight module built on top of Odin's API

## Requirements
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API
- Fabric Language Kotlin
- **Odin** (required)

## Why PartyGuard?
Odin's default autokick is too limited. PartyGuard gives you full control 
over who gets kicked from your party and when.
